_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Input for ccdarksens_compute_brc --config: per-pixel k-electron rates in, random-coincidence pattern-bin counts B^rc_p out (see docs/Student_Examples_Background_Pattern_Counts.md).

rates._comment: Mean number of k-electron events per pixel readout. lambda_3plus is used for every pixel holding 3, 4 or 5 electrons. The LBC best-fit values are theta = (2.9, 2.0, 2.0) with lambda_k = theta_k * 1e-4.

pixels._comment: Number of pixel readouts the rates apply to. null = sum of the Nusedpix column of the LBC image table (1,853,807,441).
